claim: axe-core has a coverage ceiling. Deque's own figure is about 57% of WCAG issues found automatically, and axe returns uncertain cases as "incomplete" for human review. Independent or semi-independent measurements are lower. In the UK GDS test of 13 tools on 142 known barriers, axe caught about 29% (27% in a related write-up). Evinced, a vendor with an interest, reports that axe-core found 22.6% of issues in 35 manual audits. Many of these sources are secondary or vendor-authored, so I did not verify them against the primary studies.
evidence: axe-core GitHub README: 'on average 57% of WCAG issues' automatically; returns 'incomplete' where uncertain [search idx 15-1, 15-2]
GDS test of 13 tools on 142 barriers: axe 29%, best tool 40% (secondary source accessibility.works) [12-12:12-15]
Evinced Jan 2026 vendor study: axe-core 22.6% vs Evinced 62.8% of manually reported issues [12-8:12-10]
18-6: the 57% figure is the vendor's estimate, not an independent audit
